statements.text: This bill directs Small Business Development Centers to help small businesses evaluate and adopt artificial intelligence by providing guidance, training, and outreach.
statements.context: Markup hearing before the House Small Business Committee on several bills including H.R. 5764, the AI for Main Street Act.

statements.text: A lot of people are talking about AI these days. Will it overtake America? Will it put businessowners and workers out of business? This bill is designed to get ahead of that and to make sure that does not happen.
statements.context: Floor remarks by Rep. Alford advocating for the AI for Main Street Act, which directs SBDCs to help small businesses adopt AI tools.
